text.p: Chartwell Leisure Inc said on Monday that it will pay HFS Inc $9.5 million in cash and a promissory note as a result of the companies terminating a corporate services agreement.
Chartwell said it will post a $9.5 million charge in the fourth quarter.
Under the corporate services agreement, Chartwell was obligated to pay HFS a fee of $1.5 million each year until 2019.
The termination is expected to be effective December 31.
A spokeswoman, Barbara Glassman, said the agreement had been in effect since 1994, when Chartwell was known as National Gaming Corp and when it shared corporate staff with HFS.
Glassman said the companies decided to terminate the agreement since Chartwell now has its own corporate staff.
-- Lisa Marie Pane, New York newsdesk, 212 859-1700.
